conversion.method: full MIDI arrangement for solo acoustic/classical guitar
adaptations: voice mapped to upper guitar strings
bass moved by octaves into guitar range and mapped to lower strings
drums converted to guitar body percussion, muted-string slaps and rasgueado
simultaneous notes assigned to unique strings

arrangement_notes.playability_note: The arrangement retains all source layers; some pitches are octave-revoiced to fit one standard-tuned guitar.
